sloka: भवितव्यतया नूनम् इदम् वा व्यसनम् महत् ।कुलस्य अस्य विनाशाय प्राप्तम् सूत यदृच्चया ॥२-५९-२०॥
transliteration: bhavitavyatayā nūnam idam vā vyasanam mahat ।kulasya asya vināśāya prāptam sūta yadṛccayā ॥2-59-20॥

translations.english: O maharaja, Ayodhya is filled with cheerless people with deep sighs, agonised voices and pale faces depressed and distressed due to Rama's exile. (Even) elephants and horses look spiritless. For me it (the city) resembles (dejected) Kausalya deprived of her son.
translations.hindi: न्क w= अयाध्याकाएड राजभवन के भीतर भी सवत्र महाराज दशरथ की रानियों का जो श्रीरामचन्द्र क शोक से सन्तप्त थीं, धीमें स्वर में विलाप सुन पड़ता था
